registros.pergunta: Qual foi o campeão com a maior taxa de banimento em 2026?

resultados.sql:
SELECT c.champion_name, COUNT(DISTINCT b.match_id)::float / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM matches WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM game_creation) = 2026) AS ban_rate
FROM bans b
JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = b.match_id
JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT champion_id, champion_name FROM participants) c ON c.champion_id = b.champion_id
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m.game_creation) = 2026
GROUP BY c.champion_name
ORDER BY ban_rate DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

registros.pergunta: Quais jogadores tiveram uma taxa de vitória superior a 70% em 2026, considerando pelo menos 20 partidas?

FROM participants pa
JOIN players p ON p.puuid = pa.puuid

WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m.game_creation) = 2026
GROUP BY p.puuid, p.game_name, p.tag_line
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20 AND AVG(pa.win::int) > 0.7

WHERE pg.year = 2026
GROUP BY pp.player_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pg.game_id) >= 20 AND AVG(pp.win::int) > 0.7
ORDER BY win_rate DESC NULLS LAST;

registros.pergunta: Qual jogador apresentou o maior KDA em uma única partida, considerando apenas partidas com pelo menos uma morte?

resultados.sql:
SELECT p.puuid, pl.game_name, pl.tag_line, p.kills, p.deaths, p.assists,

registros.pergunta: Qual equipe teve a maior sequência de vitórias consecutivas em 2026?

resultados.sql:
SELECT team_name, MAX(seq) AS maior_sequencia FROM (
  SELECT team_name, COUNT(*) AS seq FROM (
    SELECT team_name, win,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY team_name ORDER BY game_date, game_id)
         - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY team_name, win ORDER BY game_date, game_id) AS grp
    FROM pro_games WHERE year = 2026) t
  WHERE win GROUP BY team_name, grp) s
GROUP BY team_name ORDER BY maior_sequencia DESC LIMIT 1;

registros.pergunta: Qual equipe apresentou a maior sequência de derrotas consecutivas?

resultados.sql:
SELECT team_name, MAX(seq) AS maior_sequencia_derrotas FROM (
  SELECT team_name, COUNT(*) AS seq FROM (
    SELECT team_name, win,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY team_name ORDER BY game_date, game_id)
         - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY team_name, win ORDER BY game_date, game_id) AS grp
    FROM pro_games) t
  WHERE NOT win GROUP BY team_name, grp) s
GROUP BY team_name ORDER BY maior_sequencia_derrotas DESC LIMIT 1;

registros.pergunta: Qual foi a equipe com mais vitórias em cada uma das principais ligas profissionais de 2026?

SELECT league, team_name, wins FROM (
  SELECT league, team_name, SUM(CASE WHEN win THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wins,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY league ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN win THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC) AS rn
  FROM pro_games
  WHERE year = 2026 AND league IN ('LCK','LPL','LEC','LCP','LTA','LCS','CBLOL')
  GROUP BY league, team_name
) t
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY league;
